description: This file defines the MessengerInterface interface for handling runtime user messages in Drupal, including methods for adding, retrieving, and deleting messages of various types.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds a new message to the queue with specified type and repeat options.

methods.name: addStatus
methods.description: Adds a new status message to the queue.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds a new error message to the queue.

methods.name: addWarning
methods.description: Adds a new warning message to the queue.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Retrieves all messages grouped by type.

methods.name: messagesByType
methods.description: Retrieves all messages of a specific type.

methods.name: deleteByType
methods.description: Deletes all messages of a specific type.
